visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt with a small Bitcoin logo on the sleeve sits in front of a professional Shure SM7B microphone. He gestures with both hands as he speaks toward the camera. (2) A woman wearing a medical mask and a white-and-black patterned fleece jacket stands in a parking garage, looking at a black Tesla Model Y through glass. Red and white balloons are visible in the background. (3) A digital document titled "Vehicle Order Agreement" for a Tesla is shown on screen, listing various car specs and pricing in TWD. (4) Close-up shots of a black Tesla Model Y's exterior, focusing on the hood and the 21-inch wheels with red brake calipers. (5) The man returns to the screen, speaking with an expressive facial expression and holding up his fingers to emphasize points. (6) A screen recording shows a mouse cursor navigating the Tesla official website, filling in car details like mileage and model. (7) A trade-in valuation result appears on the screen for a 2023 Tesla Model Y with 54,700 km, showing a price of NT$1,378,000. (8) The man speaks while mathematical symbols and pink heart graphics appear around him. (9) A final black screen displays a QR code in the center with several lines of white text inviting viewers to join a LINE group chat.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Model Y 三年後 我虧了????萬. [Logo]: @IAMDADDY. (2) [Subtitle]: 我的Model Y 2022年首批P版. (3) [Subtitle]: 當初車價是260萬 加上選黑色的3.75萬. (4) [Subtitle]: EAP 11萬 總共大約是275萬. (5) [Subtitle]: 因為關稅還有改款的問題. (6) [Subtitle]: 很多人推薦讓特斯拉直接回購. (7) [Subtitle]: 比二手商價格更好 整個流程很簡單. (8) [Subtitle]: 從網頁登入帳號後 填好一些資料. (9) [Subtitle]: 大概過了兩天 就會收到報價單. (10) [Subtitle]: 我開了將近三年 回收價是137萬. (11) [Subtitle]: 跟我強的是差不多 275 - 137 = @#$%^. (12) [Subtitle]: 這個數學有點難 親愛的老婆大人. (13) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講我下一台一定會開10年. (14) [Subtitle]: 而且開電車的快樂是無價的啊. (15) [Subtitle]: 提醒大家有時候就是先買先享受. (16) [Subtitle]: 但是荷包就比較... 記得掃QR code. (17) [Subtitle]: 加入老爸電車LINE群 一起討論特斯拉電動車.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's financial experience of selling a Tesla Model Y back to the official trade-in program after three years. It aims to inform other EV owners about depreciation rates and the convenience of official buyback programs while building community via a LINE group.
